name: Carved stones
kicker: Carved stones in the valley fields
summary: Carved stones about 7 km out: stop among the terraces in daylight for the rocks in the Muong Hoa fields. The stones sit at Hầu Thào, Sử Pán, and Tả Van, with the largest group around Hầu Thào. Sun World’s article dates a national relic to October 1994 and names Victor Goloubev in August 1925. The operator article puts the ride at about 15 minutes by motorbike.
getThere: About 7 km southeast. About 15 minutes by motorbike, or 15–20 by car, on the operator article.
heroCaption: A carved stone among the Muong Hoa terraces
body: The stones lie in the Muong Hoa fields at Hầu Thào, Sử Pán, and Tả Van, about 7 km southeast of town. Most of them cluster around Hầu Thào. You look at the carved faces, with the terraces around the rocks. Sun World’s article counts more than 200 stones across about 8 km², and it places one field of more than 100 stones on the border of Hầu Thào and Lao Chải.

The same article dates a national historical-cultural relic to October 1994, recognized by the Ministry of Culture and Information, and names Victor Goloubev in August 1925. A 2023 CafeBiz table prints the stones as free. Read the site before you assume a ticket. The operator article puts the ride at about 15 minutes by motorbike and 15–20 minutes by car.
